title: Interview: John Lennon for Los Angeles Times | 1980
content:
John Lennon continued giving an interview to the Los Angeles Times on 11 October 1980.

The interview, by Robert Hilburn, had begun the previous day at the Hit Factory. It continued on this and the following day at the Dakota Building in Manhattan.

This portion of the interview focused on Lennon’s retreat from the public eye since 1975, and his life as a househusband and father to Sean Lennon.
